description: 2.0 renderer parity experiment (Workbench D-041): the same run as renderer_parity_menu_smoke with --debug-bgfx-scene-classic-glsl, which builds the bgfx scene program from the GL path's own GLSL 1.30 text (attribute names and vec4 uniform widths changed for bgfx, the arithmetic character for character). Differences that remain in the scene's surfaces do not come from the shader text. 2.0 renderer phase 2a (D5): with --renderer-parity the classic GL renderer presents and the bgfx backend renders the same frames offscreen from the same fast3d, scene-renderer and ImGui commands. Each screenshot event compares the two finished frames pixel for pixel (port/fast3d/gfx_parity.cpp): <shot> is the GL frame, <shot>.bgfx.bmp the bgfx frame, <shot>.diff.bmp the difference (x64) and <shot>.parity.json the counts. Front-end menu: Agent Select, ImGui over the 3D Carrington Institute background with the character preview. The wait is core_boot_ready plus time, not agent_select_ready: that condition needs keyboard focus, which a runner in the background does not get; for the same reason the Main Menu (a keypress away) is not captured.

input_sequence.comment: Agent Select is up about 20 s after boot completes (the menu background stage loads first).

required_lines: SCENARIO\.RENDER: --debug-bgfx-scene-classic-glsl: bgfx scene program from the GL path's GLSL text
forbidden_patterns: SCENARIO\.RENDER: --debug-bgfx-scene-classic-glsl: (GL scene shader source unavailable|attribute|uniform declarations|program not created)
